entry.title: Walmart approves 8 more parcel carriers for seller-fulfilled shipping
entry.summary: The retailer's marketplace now allows businesses to use DoorDash, UniUni and others if they are managing deliveries themselves.

entry.title: Few major apparel brands pay garment workers a living wage: report
entry.summary: Out of 110 clothing brands — including Adidas, Chanel and Zara — only four disclose workers’ wage levels at garment factories in their supply chains, a new report from Clean Clothes Campaign found.

entry.title: Cutter & Buck eyes fulfillment boost with second automated distribution center
entry.summary: The apparel brand’s new site in Grand Prairie, Texas, features over 50,000 storage bins and is equipped to process more than 1,200 bins per hour.

entry.title: Modelo, Pacifico maker stabilizes beer inventory following undersupply
entry.summary: Constellation Brands had overcorrected supply to match weaker-than-expected consumer demand, particularly among Hispanic consumers.

entry.title: Bluffworks targets lower fulfillment costs after provider switch
entry.summary: The travel apparel brand’s CEO spoke to Supply Chain Dive on making the switch to Cart.com after invoicing failures from its previous fulfillment partner.

entry.title: How Whataburger’s CSCO diversified suppliers to curb inflation — and fought fires along the way
entry.summary: The burger chain has worked to diversify its partner network, as well as tackle the rising cost of beef and diesel fuel.

entry.title: Chocolate maker signs $6.6M sale-leaseback deal for warehouse site
entry.summary: The deal for Rocky Mountain Chocolate Factory's Colorado facility, which also houses production operations and the company's headquarters, aims to cut existing debt.

entry.title: Texas sues Nestlé’s Gerber over alleged heavy metals in baby food
entry.summary: Gerber says it employs “careful ingredient sourcing, supplier requirements, testing and quality controls" to reduce heavy metal levels in its products.

entry.title: US semiconductor supply chain relies on vulnerable, hidden inputs
entry.summary: To guard against disruptions, the Semiconductor Industry Association called for closer government-industry collaboration to address targets for onshoring and stockpiling.

entry.title: Napa Auto Parts revs fulfillment efficiency with automation
entry.summary: Alongside Hy-Tek Intralogistics and Hai Robotics, the retailer aims to maximize warehouse storage density and improve order accuracy.
